name: command-menu-item
title: Command Menu Item
description: One command palette row going idle, hover, press and selected as the cursor reaches it and clicks.
useWhen: Showing a single palette row reacting to hover, press and selection.
Building a custom command list one row at a time.
avoidWhen: You need the whole palette with backdrop and typed query: use command-menu.
The list has no icons or shortcuts: use dropdown-menu.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Icon
variables.description: Icon at the start of the row.

variables.label: Shortcut
variables.description: Keyboard shortcut chip at the end of the row. Leave empty for none.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
